Name: dreamy Intro
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center][size=3][b]Dreamy Intro – Interactive Prairie King Challenge[/b][/size][/center]

[left][b]Enhance the beginning of your Stardew Valley adventure with a more immersive and interactive intro experience.[/b]

[i]Dreamy Intro –[/i] expands the game's opening sequence with subtle visual enhancements and a new gameplay challenge before your journey in Pelican Town begins.

Instead of simply watching the intro unfold, players now experience a [b]Journey of the Prairie King challenge[/b], along with cinematic visual touches that make the start of the game feel more memorable.

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Expanded Intro Features[/b]

This mod enhances the beginning of Stardew Valley with several small tweaks that add atmosphere, interaction, and personality to the opening scenes:

[list]
[*][i]When Grandpa throws the letter during the intro scene, the letter now spins through the air with a custom sound effect, adding a subtle cinematic touch to the moment that begins the player's journey.[/i]
[*]Shortly after receiving the letter, players are presented with a [b]Journey of the Prairie King[/b] challenge before the game transitions fully into the normal Stardew Valley intro.
This challenge acts as a brief skill test inspired by the classic arcade machine found later in the game.Your performance during the Prairie King challenge can reward you with optional starter bonuses when the game begins.[/list]

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Prairie King Reward System[/b]

Rewards are granted based on the number of stages completed during the challenge.

By default the reward tiers are:

[list]
[*]Stage 2 – Cowboy Hat
[*]Stage 4 – Magic Cowboy Hat
[*]Stage 8 – Blue Cowboy Hat
[*]Stage 12 – Red Cowboy Hat
[*]Stage 16 – Deluxe Cowboy Hat
[/list]

Players receive the [b]highest reward tier they qualify for[/b] when the intro finishes.

These rewards are intentionally balanced to give players a fun incentive without significantly altering the game's progression.

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Customizing Rewards[/b]

The reward system is fully configurable.

After installing the mod:

[list]
[*]Launch the game [b]once[/b]
[*]The mod will generate a config file automatically
[*]Open the generated file located in:
[i]Stardew Valley/Mods/DreamyIntro/DreamyIntroArcade/config.json[/i][/list]

Players can edit the stage thresholds and rewards manually.

Example configuration:

[code]
"PrairieStageThresholds": [2, 4, 8, 12, 16],
"PrairieStageRewards": [
"(H)0",
"(H)73",
"(H)37",
"(H)38",
"(H)81"
]
[/code]

[b]How this works:[/b]

[list]
[*]PrairieStageThresholds = stages required to earn each reward
[*]PrairieStageRewards = the item given for each tier
[*](H) indicates a hat item
[/list]

You can replace these entries with other valid Stardew Valley item IDs if you wish to customize the rewards.

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Visual Enhancements[/b]

Dreamy Intro also improves the visual atmosphere of the opening scenes with several subtle adjustments:

[list]
[*][i]A redesigned Grandpa's bed that feels more comfortable and modern[/i]
[*]A soft starry backdrop visible through the window during the intro
[*]A slightly altered Joja Corporation office scene with a touch of retro charm
[*]A recolored bird that appears during the intro sequence
[*]Optional retro scanline effect during the intro
[/list]

These changes aim to create a nostalgic and dreamy atmosphere while still preserving the spirit of the original game.

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Fully Integrated With the Vanilla Intro[/b]

This mod does not replace Stardew Valley’s original intro sequence. Instead, it adds additional elements that blend naturally into the existing scenes.

The original story, dialogue, and transitions into Pelican Town remain intact.

The goal is simply to expand the intro experience while keeping it faithful to the vanilla game.

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Configurable Options[/b]

The mod includes several configuration options so players can customize their experience.

[list]
[*]Enable or disable the Prairie King intro challenge
[*]Enable or disable Prairie King reward tiers
[*]Toggle intro scanline effects
[*]Adjust the Joja desk interaction prompt
[*]Customize reward thresholds and items
[/list]

[i]If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, these settings can be adjusted easily from within the game's mod configuration menu.[/i]

[center]────────────[/center]

[b]Compatibility[/b]

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.

This mod is designed to integrate smoothly with most other mods that do not alter the intro sequence.

[center]────────────[/center]
